video_title: Rich Paul on Turning His Lebron James Encounter Into a Sports Management Empire

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on the difference between a glass half full and empty
quotes.excerpt: if your glass is half empty, then I think you're putting yourself in position to where you can pour new cup
quotes.quote: I always put things in perspective of life. Sometimes the way people think can determine the difference between one of those two things. If your glass is half empty, then I think it allows you to put yourself in a position of strength, given the fact that you've dumped most of the negativity. In my life, there was a lot of trauma, a lot of negativity, a lot of discouragement from others, so you wouldn't leave the nest of nothing. If your glass is half empty, then I think you're putting yourself in position to where you can pour new cup of whatever that is you want to pour.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on the foundational influence of his father
quotes.excerpt: my dad allowed me to have perspective, my dad really laid down the foundational principles
quotes.quote: The biggest one is my dad being in my life. My dad allowed me to have perspective, my dad really laid down the foundational principles of what it really took to be a man, to be a good person. We had a no excuse policy in our household and so accountability was very important. He taught us the importance of not valuing things, which again, as you become more and more successful, if you don't have a perspective on this stuff, you find yourself getting lost.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his mindset after losing his father
quotes.excerpt: my mindset was, I don't want to disappoint my father. I had so much respect for my dad
quotes.quote: When my dad finally did move on, my mindset was, I don't want to disappoint my father. I had so much respect for my dad and I knew right from wrong, just like many of us. We know right from wrong and I was in a very tough environment. I definitely had a conversation with myself that I wasn't going to be a failure, no matter what. I knew the importance of decision making, I knew the importance of not being a follower, I knew the importance of being willing to say no and this is not for me.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on the challenges of being a young Black agent
quotes.excerpt: in this industry I'm in, being young, being Black, being not following their rules
quotes.quote: In this industry I'm in, being young, being Black, being not following their rules and things of that nature, from people that look like me and from others behind the scenes, still to this day with all my success, there's not a time where a competitive agent from any one of these other agencies don't go into a household and speak negative about me without even knowing me. They lead with that.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on earning his position in the sports agency world
quotes.excerpt: I've earned my positions, no question about it. No one in my industry has evolved to the level
quotes.quote: I've earned my positions, no question about it. No one in my industry has evolved to the level that I've gotten to in terms of not just being agent and really adding layers of depth to my capabilities and my positioning and my perception and all that. And I've earned that of the biggest and the best. My circles are the real decision makers and disruptors and people who built great businesses. I definitely have that respect and I'm appreciative of that because you don't get here by yourself either.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on reconciling his father's complicated nature
quotes.excerpt: the things that people would perceive of complication, we looked at as normal
quotes.quote: The things that people would perceive of complication, we looked at as normal. So I didn't really know the merit or the lack thereof of merit within. My dad had me, he was married. I didn't necessarily change my perspective in any capacity, it was just the situation. How you handle that situation, I had respect for his wife and I had respect for my mom. When I went to my dad's house, his wife treated me with, she welcomed me with open arms. It was all good.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his early hustle and love for fashion
quotes.excerpt: I just love fashion. I love clothes, I love shoes, all those things
quotes.quote: I just love fashion. I love clothes, I love shoes, all those things and one day on a trip to New York, just shopping on Fifth Avenue, a young kid shopping on Fifth Avenue, I happen to go into the NBA store because I was looking for a jersey, actually the Latrell Sprewell jersey I was looking for to match my Bo Jacksons. It was less about Latrell, even though I rock with Latrell, it was more about the colorway of the jersey because I wanted the black outlining of the eight to match my black Bo Jacksons that I had on ice for about six months.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his bond with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I think we bonded amongst over our moms, because I wasn't from Akron
quotes.quote: I think we bonded amongst over our moms, because I wasn't from Akron and everyone was wondering why you got this guy around you pretty much. I didn't expect me being in the position I'm in and you get a lot of people on these social media platforms that have a lot to say without really understanding the journey.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on the organic growth of Klutch Sports
quotes.excerpt: it was a very organic thing, Craig. I didn't come into the space wanting to be an agent
quotes.quote: It was a very organic thing, Craig. I didn't come into the space wanting to be an agent at all. Growing up, it wasn't like I wanted to be an agent. That wasn't the case. You couldn't even see them. But once I got into this space, I knew basketball, I knew business, I knew people. Knowing people was very important, having a relatability and having a willingness to educate all the time. I was so experienced at such a young age that I could talk about a number of different things and enlighten people on a number of different things.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on the challenges of being a decision maker
quotes.excerpt: people still aren't comfortable with leadership looking how I look. I'm talking about the sole decision maker
quotes.quote: People still aren't comfortable with leadership looking how I look. I'm talking about the sole decision maker, not someone who works at a company and is a head of something. I'm talking about the decision maker. Whether it's ownership, control is another thing. Yeah, still, still, yeah. Because you can see, because from the outside looking in, Rich, it seems like things are going pretty well. When Rich Paul walks in a room now, it's a lot different than it was yesterday, no question about it. I'm not saying that. But I'm saying we still have to work on getting people consistently comfortable.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his impact on the next generation
quotes.excerpt: everywhere I go, kids like, bro, you really changed my life, man. I want to be an agent
quotes.quote: Everywhere I go, kids like, bro, you really changed my life, man. I want to be an agent because of you, I want to do this because of you. That to me, trumps any dollar amount, man, because like that is impact. When I was growing up, I didn't know what an agent was, didn't have that identification. Today, people see me and know, they know how to identify what an agent was. And today, being an agent is probably 1/18th of what I do.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his organic relationship with Adele
quotes.excerpt: I never try to get fresh with people that's in comfortable circles because they always have to deal
quotes.quote: I never try to get fresh with people that's in comfortable circles because they always have to deal with that. So that was never my thing. It was it was really something that that happened very organically, really.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on the best advice he received from his father
quotes.excerpt: my dad told me you once a man, twice a child, son
quotes.quote: My dad told me you once a man, twice a child, son. And I never understood what that meant. And he said, growing up, you're a baby, you grow to become a man, how you treat people along the way will determine when you grow old and become a baby again, how they treat you.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his mother's strength and his father's recovery
quotes.excerpt: my mom was a very strong, strong woman. Regardless of what she was going through, we wouldn't see
quotes.quote: My mom was a very strong, strong woman. Regardless of what she was going through, we wouldn't see it. She would never let us see it. I tell all my players, cherish your parents, man, cherish your mother, cherish your father. You only get one mom. So regardless of what they may be going through, you got to support them and really and really and really love them because you know, a lot of a lot of times we don't know why. I come to learn the reason why my mom was in this present as she probably would have wanted to be is the same reason why I thank her today for not being as present as I would have wanted her to be in that time, because I don't have a visual of her in that space.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on the importance of perseverance
quotes.excerpt: I don't take any of this stuff personal. I think it's important for you to have a perspective
quotes.quote: I don't take any of this stuff personal. I think it's important for you to have a perspective. Perspective is so important in life. And yeah, man, and so, you know, but I didn't let that stop me. I didn't let that stop me at all. It's part of it, you know. I think the dents in the man's armor show he's battle tested and so I've always been of that regard and how I was, how I grew up, you got challenged every single day, so that wasn't really a challenge to me.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his creative process and drive
quotes.excerpt: I'm a creative at heart, Craig. I don't know if you know that
quotes.quote: Man, I'm a creative at heart, Craig. I don't know if you know that. I'm always like ideating and so I was just saying the other day like, some days I wake up and I feel so unaccomplished and I think when I get in that space, I know it's just me being creative though. No, I'm saying I know it's just like, that's like a a push from yourself like, you know, to not be complacent, to not be satisfied, to not sit in your success.

quotes.speaker: Rich Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul on his legacy and opening doors for others
quotes.excerpt: my trailblazing led to the door being open for others. I don't want to go through that door
quotes.quote: My trailblazing led to the door being open for others. I don't want to go through that door and close it. I want to go through that door and leave it open. I want to open as many doors as I possibly can for those to come in behind me. That's what is what I want.
